units.source_text: 这个发现，就像微风把沙子和汗渐渐分离开来一样，立刻就软化了他感情上的僵硬。

en.t: This discovery, like a breeze gradually separating sand from sweat, at once softened the stiffness in his feelings.

units.source_text: 即使由此带来些过头的想法也不可避免。

en.t: Even if it led him into somewhat excessive thoughts, that was unavoidable.

units.source_text: 曾有过破掉几层铁格子，打破钢筋混凝土墙壁逃出去的人。

en.t: There had been people who broke through several layers of iron bars, smashed reinforced concrete walls, and escaped.

units.source_text: 显然不会有人没去确认门是否上锁，看到锁就吓成一团……

en.t: Obviously, no one would fail to check whether the door was locked and then collapse in fear just at the sight of the lock...

units.source_text: 男人慢慢地，迈着脚底发黏的步子，迎着小屋，走了回去……

en.t: The man slowly walked back toward the hut, taking steps with the soles of his feet sticking...

units.source_text: 冷静下来，这次一定要从女人那，打听出所有需要知道的事情……

en.t: Calm down; this time he had to get every necessary piece of information out of the woman...

units.source_text: 那样冲动，又是大叫大喊，那女人沉默不语也不是没有道理的……

en.t: After he had been so impulsive and had shouted like that, it was not unreasonable for the woman to remain silent...

units.source_text: 而且，那沉默，也许只不过是她害臊的一种表现吧，自己糊里糊涂地被人看到了裸体睡相。

en.t: Besides, that silence might simply have been a sign of her embarrassment, since someone had inadvertently seen her sleeping naked.
